quarterly_data.quarter: Lite-On press release: LITEON Technology Reports Consolidated September Sales of (10-08-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: September 2026 consolidated revenue NT$18.8 billion, up 22% Y-o-Y; January-September cumulative sales NT$153.6 billion, up 26% Y-o-Y. The company attributes the growth mainly to high-end server power systems for cloud and AI applications, high-efficiency backup battery units (BBU) and advanced opto-electronic semiconductors. Segment mix: Cloud & AIoT 59% of sales, with yearly growth over 50% on delivery growth of power management systems for high-end datacenter servers and cloud computing; Opto-electronics 14% of sales, 10% Y-o-Y growth (photocouplers for industrial automation, new energy and AI power; visible LED indicators for AI servers and switches); Information Technology & Consumer Electronics 27% of sales, with demand for LEO satellite power systems and advanced power supplies continuing to grow steadily.
